behaviors.given: an admitted completion, exercised once per failure shape: (a) a precondition refusal — an invalid replacement pair, and a refusing gate / blank provenance — with this attempt still the trailing `PENDING` event; (b) a locked recheck lost only because persisted scope no longer fingerprints to the `PENDING` event's `scopeFingerprint`, with this attempt still the trailing `PENDING` event; and (c) a lineage whose trailing event is no longer this attempt's `PENDING` event — planted as a `ROLLED_BACK` event for this attempt, and separately as a fresh `PENDING` event for a second `attemptId` admitted after it, each also driven through the `beforeLockAcquired`-style interleave seam so the change lands after the pair read
behaviors.when: `completeRecoveryAttempt` runs, appending no `COMPLETED` event in any shape and writing no restore, no rollback and no `ROLLED_BACK`/`ROLLBACK_FAILED` append of its own; in shapes (a) and (b) — and only after a read has found the target's trailing event still this `attemptId` in state `PENDING`, because `rollBackRecoveryAttempt` takes no `attemptId` and acts on whatever `rollbackableEvent` returns (`src/preserve-work-recovery.ts:1369-1390`, predicate `:1293-1302`, trailing-only recheck `:1412-1422`) — it delegates to #333's verified rollback writer after the transaction has returned and released the lock, the way `reconcileRecoveryLineage` already calls it (`:1689-1701`)
behaviors.then: shape (a) ends through `rollBackRecoveryAttempt` with `trigger: "deterministic-validation-refusal"` or `trigger: "lock-gate-refusal"`; shape (b) ends through the same writer with the new `trigger: "completion-cas-lost"`; and shape (c) appends nothing, restores nothing and calls no rollback at all, returning the module's existing refusal code `facts-changed-before-lock` (`:133-134`) naming this `attemptId` and the observed trailing `attemptId` and state. Shape (c) is not delegated because delegation would let a completion roll back an attempt it never admitted — after a `ROLLED_BACK` event `hasOpenRecoveryAttempt` is false (`:577-583`), so a fresh `PENDING` attempt can be trailing and the unedited writer would restore *that* attempt's snapshot and append for it — and P-02 forbids the alternative of teaching the writer an `attemptId`
